summary: The agency accepted the industry-reported range of test procedure impacts and recalculated gasoline savings relative to MY 1976 procedures to remove the uncertainty introduced by the new test procedures, presenting adjusted mpg ranges for both NPA classes.
text: Because of the uncertainty of the impact of the MY 1979 procedures, savings have been determined relative to the MY 1976 procedures. This means that the range of fuel economies for which gasoline savings are determined is based only on the possible fuel economy penalty of the MY 1979 emission standard. For the two possible classes of NPA's, the ranges of 14.9 mpg to 17.4 mpg for recreational-type NPA's with off-road capabilites reduces to 16.2 mpg to 17.4 mpg when the effect of the test procedure changes are deleted, the range of 16.4 mpg to 18.7 mpg for all other NPA's reduces to 17.8 mpg to 18.7 mpg.
